integrity: The complete finite bound is proved by analytic linearization and an exact integer spectral certificate. Numerical eigenvalue approximations are supplementary; independent scientific validation and publication-priority confirmation have not occurred.
limitations: Only unweighted five-cycle, graph-distance balls, counting measure and real strong ell^2; no infinite-family or other-exponent theorem.
title: Exact uncentered Hilbert maximal norm on the five-cycle
